limitations: Existing evaluation has already been observed; this is post-hoc retention, not a new independent evaluation or a prespecified adoption test.
603 patients are nested in 36 synthetic environments, three environments per profile; no pooled real-world efficacy estimate or independent-patient significance claim.
Equal capped arrival time can hide a success loss. Selection, arrival and treatment transitions are reported separately.

Research H1 uses weighted unassigned sum then weighted travel, 2048 evaluations and a 10-second technical guard. The server uses lexicographic priority counts and integer treatment schedules with a 3-second CP-SAT budget.
The current-snapshot resource audit is not full resource-history reconstruction, global online optimality, future outcome protection or clinical safety validation.
Future waiting-aware fairness rules are unvalidated candidates. New objectives, permitted deterioration and failure rules must be frozen before unused evaluation data.
The 67-minute research worsening remains unresolved. Retaining the current server policy does not make that experimental result disappear.
